I didn't want it to go hungry or die, so I took it home to feed it. That seems kind because I was trying to help it survive. But then, after feeding it, I made it into taxidermy. Taxidermy is when you preserve an animal's body, usually for display. Now, I need to think about the implications of each action. Taking the animal home might have been necessary to save its life, but what about the long-term effects? If the animal was in the wild, maybe it had a role in its ecosystem. By taking it out, I might have disrupted that balance. Also, if the animal was part of a protected species, taking it without proper authorization could be illegal.
